fix_verification.issue: Events blocks only run the last code placed on canvas instead of responding to keyboard/mouse events in real-time
fix_verification.root_cause: eventHandlersRef was not being updated before startEventMode checked it due to React's asynchronous state updates
fix_verification.fix_applied: Use eventHandlers directly from useMemo (not the ref) and add it to useCallback dependencies
fix_verification.verification_status: Code review confirms fix is correct. Unable to verify runtime behavior due to auth requirements.

notes: The Events blocks are only available in TurtleBlocklyEditor component
TurtleBlocklyEditor is used in: AssignmentLibrary (Create/Edit dialogs), AssignmentPage (block assignments)
Teachers see 'Scratch Teaching Mode' when viewing block assignments - TurtleBlocklyEditor with showPreview=true is only for students
The standalone /turtle-blocks page uses TurtleBlocks.jsx which has a simplified toolbox without Events
Event handlers are parsed from generated Python code using regex patterns in parseEventHandlers()
Keyboard events are captured via window.addEventListener('keydown') when eventModeActive is true
